issues.description: The controller method for listing all persons has different visibility between template and solution. In the template PersonResource.getAllPersons() is declared public, while in the solution it is declared private. This visibility mismatch is unexpected for a Spring MVC controller handler method and may confuse students and lead to runtime mapping issues or inconsistent examples.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the getAllPersons() method public in the solution (change 'private' to 'public') so the controller method visibility matches the template and typical Spring MVC expectations. Ensure all controller endpoint methods use a consistent and appropriate visibility (public) across template and solution.
